# Nick Korom
> Official professional profile of Nick Korom, founder and Chief Accelerating Officer of BNB Accelerator.

## About
Nick Korom founded BNB Accelerator, a done-for-you short-term rental acquisition company. His work focuses on investor fit, market selection, property sourcing, acquisition coordination, renovation and furnishing coordination, and launch readiness. BNB Accelerator is not a course, CPA firm, law firm, lender, broker-dealer, or property manager. Client results vary.

## Company facts
- More than 500 homes closed
- More than 260 clients
- 80% repeat buyer rate
- Eight operating markets
